Digital Marketing

Digital Marketing & Account Executive

  • Full-time
  • Hybrid
  • Nicosia
Apply for this role ↓ Takes about five minutes. CV and cover letter required.

About the role

We’re looking for a Digital Marketing & Account Executive to join the avocadots crew. If you enjoy working with different brands, understand digital marketing, communicate confidently with clients and like turning ideas into clear actions, this might be the role for you.

You’ll work closely with clients and our internal team to understand business goals, contribute to digital strategy, plan content and campaigns, and help keep accounts moving in the right direction.

You won’t be doing everything alone. You’ll collaborate with designers, videographers, PPC specialists and the wider avocadots team to bring strategies and ideas to life.

What you’ll be doing

  • Managing and building relationships with a portfolio of clients.
  • Understanding client goals, priorities and upcoming needs.
  • Coordinating communication, feedback, approvals and next steps.
  • Contributing to digital marketing strategies and campaign ideas.
  • Leading or contributing to monthly content planning.
  • Researching content ideas, trends and opportunities relevant to each client.
  • Developing or reviewing digital copy in Greek and English.
  • Preparing clear creative briefs for designers and multimedia team members.
  • Working closely with our PPC team to align campaigns, messaging and creative.
  • Reviewing work to ensure it aligns with the wider strategy and client objectives.
  • Bringing proactive ideas and recommendations rather than simply waiting for briefs.
  • Helping identify opportunities to strengthen and grow client accounts.
  • Contributing ideas to avocadots’ own marketing and content where relevant.

What we’re looking for

You don’t need to be equally strong in every area.

You might come from an account management background with a strong interest in digital marketing, or from a digital marketing background with experience working directly with clients.

What matters most is that you can think clearly, communicate well, stay organised and take ownership.

We’d love to meet someone who:

  • Has previous experience in digital marketing, social media, account management or a related role.
  • Understands how the main social media and digital marketing channels work.
  • Can communicate confidently and professionally with clients.
  • Writes well in both Greek and English.
  • Can manage multiple accounts, priorities and deadlines without losing the details.
  • Enjoys developing ideas and thinking beyond the immediate brief.
  • Understands how content, creative and paid campaigns work together.
  • Can give clear creative direction and constructive feedback.
  • Is organised, proactive and comfortable taking responsibility for their work.
  • Works well as part of a collaborative team.
  • Is curious about brands, marketing, digital platforms and what makes people pay attention.

Agency experience is a plus, but it isn’t essential.

What you’ll get

  • A hybrid working model, combining days at our Nicosia office with working from home.
  • The opportunity to work with brands across a variety of industries.
  • Hands-on involvement across digital strategy, content, campaigns and client relationships.
  • Collaboration with specialists across design, video, PPC, web and digital marketing.
  • Exposure to real client projects from strategy through execution.
  • Space to bring your own ideas to the table.
  • Opportunities to develop your skills and grow within avocadots.
  • A team environment where collaboration, ownership and fresh thinking are part of how we work.

Think you’d be a good fit?
